title: FILT3R: Latent State Adaptive Kalman Filter for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2603.18493v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction maintains a persistent latent state that is updated online from incoming frames, enabling constant-memory inference. A key failure mode is the state update rule: aggressive overwrites forget useful history, while conservative updates fail to track new evidence, and both behaviors become unstable beyond the training horizon. To address this challenge, we propose FILT3R, a training-free latent filtering layer that casts recurrent state updates as stochastic state estimation in token space. FILT3R maintains a per-token variance and computes a Kalman-style gain that adaptively balances memory retention against new observations. Process noise -- governing how much the latent state is expected to change between frames -- is estimated online from EMA-normalized temporal drift of candidate tokens. translated_abstract: 流式三维重建维护一个持久的潜在状态，该状态从传入的帧中在线更新，从而实现恒定内存推理。一个关键的失效模式在于状态更新规则：激进的覆盖会遗忘有用的历史信息，而保守的更新则无法跟踪新的证据，并且这两种行为在超出训练范围后都会变得不稳定。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了FILT3R，这是一种无需训练的潜在滤波层，它将循环状态更新建模为token空间中的随机状态估计。FILT3R为每个token维护一个方差，并计算卡尔曼风格的增益，以自适应地平衡记忆保持与新观测之间的关系。过程噪声——即控制潜在状态在帧之间预期变化程度的参数——通过候选token的EMA归一化时间漂移在线估计。通过大量实验，我们证明FILT3R提供了一个可解释的、即插即用的更新规则，该规则能够……
tldr: FILT3R提出了一种无需训练的潜在滤波层，将循环状态更新建模为token空间中的随机状态估计，通过在线估计过程噪声并计算卡尔曼风格增益，自适应平衡记忆保持与新观测，从而解决流式三维重建中状态更新不稳定的问题。
en_tdlr: FILT3R introduces a training-free latent filtering layer that casts recurrent state updates as stochastic state estimation in token space, estimating process noise online and computing a Kalman-style gain to adaptively balance memory retention against new observations for stable streaming 3D reconstruction.
